baseline_reproduction.note: union of strong/medium/free-text/client-mix; expected ~439 vs data/raw/adv_candidates.jsonl

data_availability_findings.era_feed_location: No separate ERA compilation report exists in the SEC programmatic manifest. The manifest publishes exactly 3 feeds: IA_FIRM_SEC_Feed (RIA+ERA combined), IA_FIRM_STATE_Feed, IA_INDVL_Feed. ERAs are inside the SEC firm feed, flagged Rgstn/@FirmType=ERA. All 6557 ERAs already analyzed locally.
data_availability_findings.sec_foia_landing_pages: Old sec.gov FOIA ADV-data landing URLs now 404; the CompilationReports manifest is the authoritative programmatic source.

baseline_strong_regex_plural_gap.finding: Baseline STRONG_NAME_PATTERNS uses  family\s+office  (singular) which silently drops firms named ...Family Offices (plural).
baseline_strong_regex_plural_gap.fix: change office to offices? ; recovers 11 near-certain genuine FOs at ~90pct precision

state_feed_adjacent.note: Same ADV XML format, filed with states (advisers typically <100M AUM). BEYOND assigned ADV+ERA scope but same classifiers apply. Item5 client-mix detail is sparse for state filers so structural tiers not evaluated here; name+domain signal only.

precision_estimates_ESTIMATE.basis: Estimates, not measured. Grounded in (a) manual read of net-new sample firm names per tier, (b) known base rate 24 affirmed / 59 enriched = 41pct on baseline-quality candidates. Genuine-FO = would affirm as a real family office (MFO/SFO) under human adjudication.

baseline_439.reasoning: blended: name/free-text family-office tiers high, client_mix(162) and medium(54) lower; 41pct measured on the enriched subset

w_name_family_broad_netnew_29.reasoning: includes 11 plural family-offices (near-certain) + family-branded wealth shops; noise from real-estate multi-family/single-family + family-ventures VC

w_domain_family_netnew_29.reasoning: firm bought a *familyoffice*.com domain = presents as FO; noise e.g. oakwoodmultifamily.com (real estate)

w_domain_fo_abbrev_netnew_marginal_1.reasoning: all but 1 already in domain_family; near-zero marginal value

w_other_family_desc_netnew_45.reasoning: client-type free-text says family LP/trust; mostly ordinary RIAs with some family accounts (Wells Fargo, RBC, Plante Moran); a minority are real SFOs (Okabena, Ulysses, Dumaine)

w_struct_fewclients_highraum_netnew_128.reasoning: few clients + >100M RAUM does NOT distinguish FO from boutique hedge fund / concentrated institutional manager; sample is dominated by hedge funds (Ortelius, Atom, Peconic, Nicholas)

state_feed_family_signal_116.reasoning: state-registered ...Family Office named firms are typically genuine small MFOs; lower AUM, thinner contact data

reachability_verdict.question: Can affirmed-family-office classes alone reach 500 records?
reachability_verdict.total_distinct_candidate_universe_ADV_ER: 439 baseline + 222 net-new widened = 661 distinct firms (every family-name/domain/free-text/structural signal, RIA+ERA)
reachability_verdict.verdict: ADV + ERA ALONE CANNOT REACH 500 AFFIRMED. Absolute candidate ceiling across every tier is ~661 firms; at realistic affirm rates the affirmed ceiling is ~180-250. Net-new beyond the current 439 baseline is 222 candidates (190 enrichable-with-website), yielding ~60-70 additional affirmed.
reachability_verdict.to_reach_500: Requires sources beyond SEC-registered ADV+ERA. Highest-value adjacent: (1) STATE adviser feed (+~116 family-signal candidates, ~50pct affirm = ~55, same format, download now); (2) IRS 990-PF private foundations (per ADR-0004, family foundations = SFO proxies); (3) 13F filers; (4) fix plural regex (+11 immediately). Even summing ADV+ERA+state+990-PF, 500 AFFIRMED genuine-FO is aggressive and likely needs commercial-list augmentation.
